ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels to 20% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of two large, contiguous high-intensity white regions separated by a vertical low-intensity black column at the median notch. Low-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous border along the entire trailing and leading edge. Distinct low-intensity circular blobs are present in the medial-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes (2-8 pixels) along the continuous linear boundary; peaks are most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) visible on the distal tips and leading edges. Multiple dark circular clusters (scars) located in the mid-right lobe section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned low-intensity linear streaks visible in the lower-left and upper-right quadrants of the white surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible barnacle colonization on distal tips; significant low-intensity mottling and irregular scarring at the peduncle-fluke junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Specific cluster of three dark, well-defined spots in a triangular formation located in the central-medial region of the right lobe.
